note: The template every other topic config is copied from. Three things change per topic: the award bodies and editorial lists that actually exist for this food, the facet axis, and the title strings. The method in .claude/skills/consensus-guide/SKILL.md does not change.

awardBodies.name: 50 Top Pizza Europa
awardBodies.note: Italian panel judging Neapolitan technique. Publishes a ranked European top 50 with a year on it.

awardBodies.name: National Pizza Awards
awardBodies.note: READ THIS BEFORE COLLECTING. /previous-winners stops at the year before last; the current year's placings, special awards and full finalist list are at /the-uks-best-pizza. Missing that page once produced a false 'the awards are unreadable' caveat and hid six venues' tier-A awards.

editorialLists.name: Time Out
editorialLists.note: Publishes a ranked 21. Its news desk and YouTube channel are the SAME source - one masthead, one opinion.

editorialLists.name: The Infatuation
editorialLists.note: Two guides on one domain: the NYC-style power ranking IS ordered, the '19 Best Pizzas' is NOT. Never print a rank against the unordered one.

facetAxis.note: Pizza is one-dimensional. Indian needs two (region and format); seafood splits further. A longer array is the right answer, not a different method.

formatSection.title: Pub pizza
formatSection.note: A serious pizza kitchen inside somebody else's pub. No competitor treats it as a category and it is how several of the best-reviewed pizzas in London are cooked. Every entry needs an hours warning: the kitchen closes before the bar.

knownGaps: Community tier (E) is empty - no Reddit threads recorded, in a topic where Londoners argue about pizza constantly. The corpus finished 64% video.
First Seen in Restaurants v2 is a build stamp, not a discovery date, so the 'New openings' section cannot be derived from it.
No website found for Ace Pizza, Bing Bong Pizza (trades inside You Call The Shots), Lauretta's (Instagram only), Patio Pizza, Pizza Union or Purezza.
openVenueQuestions: Crisp Pizza - merged across The Chancellors (Hammersmith, the site The Infatuation ranked #1) and The Marlborough (Mayfair). One brand, two pubs, carried as Branches rows.
Bebere - suspected misspelling of Berbere from a TikTok caption. Left separate; merging on a hunch would hand Berbere a source it may not have.
Gracey's Pizza - The Infatuation ranks it #2 of 12 but places it in St Albans. Kept, flagged in the article as outside London.
Three sources labelled SYNDICATION in their quotes are still counted as independent opinions. Resolving them would take Napoli on the Road 8 -> 6 and Short Road Pizza 4 -> 3.
